usage: deskops closeout retire [-h] [--root ROOT] --task TASK --reason REASON
                               --ref REF

Remove a task that was already resolved before the ritual lifecycle.

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT      Target repository root.
  --task TASK      Task id being retired.
  --reason REASON  Why the task is already resolved.
  --ref REF        Ancestor commit id that resolved the task; repeat for more
                   refs.

Example:
  deskops closeout retire --root . --task task-fix-thing \
    --reason "Resolved before the ritual lifecycle existed" \
    --ref 3900ad4

Retire removes a task whose status is already resolved, closed, done,
complete or cancelled, or superseded, deferred or candidate with an empty
history, as pre-lifecycle tasks are. The ref must be a commit that is HEAD or
an ancestor. The status is not rewritten and the evidence gates do not run. It
makes exactly one closing commit: the task leaves the Board, the commit carries
Closeout-Mode: legacy-resolved with Closeout-Reason and one Closeout-Ref per
ref, and the run index entry is marked legacy-resolved.
